content.text: {"id": "mm7148a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "During 2020, the number of HIV tests decreased 32% from Q1 (2,471,614) to Q2 (1,682,578)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The number of persons prescribed ART did not vary"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "No. of HIV tests"}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Persons who inject drugs"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "% of persons linked to care"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the proportion with a suppressed viral load test result among those tested was stable"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the percentage who were linked to care did not vary during 2019–2020, ranging from 88.0% to 89.4%"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "persons aged ≥35 years experienced the largest quarter-to-quarter decrease in number of HIV tests"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the number of persons who received a diagnosis of HIV infection in 2020 decreased from Q1 to Q2"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "quarterly data from two large U.S. commercial laboratories"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Poisson regression models were used to assess trends in service use and outcomes by calculating the estimated quarterly percent change (EQPC)"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Poisson regression models were used to assess trends in service use and outcomes by calculating the estimated quarterly percent change (EQPC)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Laboratory and IQVIA data were analyzed to assess the change from each quarter to the following quarter"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "The EQPC for HIV testing was calculated for Q2 2019 through Q4 2019."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Data have been statistically adjusted to account for missing transmission category."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
